title: AIRLOCK: controlled approvals, impact previews and durable execution
body:
AIRLOCK places a server-owned approval boundary around Agent tool calls. Bounded SQLite operations, registered HTTP/MCP CAS tools and fixed-repository GitHub Issue creation receive impact previews and an independent reviewer decision before execution. Execution rechecks identity, scope, request, policy, version, TTL and data state.

The implementation includes durable approval states, idempotency and concurrency handling, local atomic effect/state/audit commits, remote unknown-state reconciliation, separately approved compensation, scoped audit access, batch risk checks, budgets, an approval console and trace/cost/health instrumentation. Model advice, reversibility and budgets cannot authorize writes.

The latest repair rejects missing or invalid explicitly selected startup configuration before invoking Uvicorn. Unreadable files, malformed JSON and invalid credential value types return sanitized exit 2; omitted default configuration still supports environment-only startup. Environment precedence, UTF-8 BOM and exclusive initialization remain covered. Validation includes 16 new regressions, 7 independent child-process checks and 52 related local tests.

Both the [source CI 37164846361](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/actions/runs/37164846361) at `7073fb76a2e46365fabe6f51a3765de267863890` and [delivery CI 37165779509](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/actions/runs/37165779509) at `f27b447e268209a8b8f480111e55a3f6bb1bedce` pass: 703 Python tests, 6 JavaScript tests, 31 native browser checks, official MCP SDK interop, frozen benchmarks/ablations, isolated Docker/network tests, S3 Object Lock, Envoy/OTel and dependency/evidence gates. Both downloaded ZIPs were checked against GitHub digests, all 94 payload hashes, source archive commits and real subprocess exit receipts; the functional verifier exits 0. Application and executable acceptance code are unchanged between the two commits.

Project documentation centers on use cases, setup, integration, operating boundaries and implementation priorities. The [engineering checkpoint](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/evidence/project-checkpoint-20261004/README.md) preserves source/evidence snapshots and historical provenance. The full source CI ZIP and original failure/success receipts are [archived in Git](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/tree/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/evidence/project-maintenance-20261004); 125 evidence payloads, 9 document bindings and 16 checkpoint payloads were independently read back from committed Git objects. Git has no automatic expiry and is not independent WORM custody. Source and delivery Actions copies expire on 2027-01-02; the exact timestamps and delivery verification receipts are recorded on `memory/progress`.

The [126-target ledger](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/acceptance/COMPLETION_MATRIX.json) retains every original criterion: 111 IMPLEMENTED / 15 PARTIAL, and 105 scoped PASS / 21 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Representative human/business validation and actual production identity, custody and notification environments remain open. No known unresolved P0/P1 remains in the tested scope; no production-readiness or full original-goal acceptance is claimed.

See [README](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/README.md), [development plan](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/PLAN.md), [operations](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/OPERATIONS.md) and [findings](https://github.com/Changxin-YR/AIRLOCK/blob/codex/full-audit-2026-10-02/docs/acceptance/FINDINGS_AND_FIXES.md). This PR remains draft and unmerged; main is `704b5035cf69f9a6c40c44eecd84c0d0741de849`.
